description: Any agent may challenge a rule it believes is wrong or blocking legitimate work. The rule stays enforced until a person clears the challenge; the challenge and your reason are recorded for review. Returns the rule id and state. Errors: 'Refused:' unknown or retired rule; 'Invalid:' empty reason.

reason.description: why the rule is wrong; no prompts, transcripts or code

name: hunch_challenge
title: Challenge a rule you believe is wrong
